column1: # Cloud/SaaS Sigma validation manifest — TAB-separated. Paths are repo-root-relative.
# The nested-field cloud plane: these rules match on field names zircolite's EVTX
# flattener can't preserve — dotted paths (resource.type, objectRef.resource,
# gcp.audit.method_name, request.path) and/or underscored keys it strips
# (resource_type -> resourcetype, event_type -> eventtype). So they're driven through
# sigma_eval.py, which matches the rule against natural cloud-event JSON by walking
# pysigma's OWN parsed condition tree (see run-cloud-validation.sh / README).
# Each row is checked BOTH ways: the true-positive fixture MUST fire the rule's id, and
# the true-negative (a benign near-miss) MUST NOT — so a rule that matched everything
# fails just as loudly as one that fires on nothing. Fixtures are committed JSONL under
